name: alpaca-farm-world
description: Andes-inspired pixel-art world assets for an alpaca farming sim: terrain tiles, the farmhouse (log cabin), and the barn (open run-in shelter).

art.comment_scaleMode: Never smooth/bilinear-filter these. Disable image smoothing and scale by whole integers only (2x, 3x, 4x).
art.terrainBackgrounds: opaque (full-bleed, meant to fill the ground grid)
art.buildingBackgrounds: transparent RGBA; a soft contact shadow is baked into the base of each building

terrain.comment: All terrain tiles are 32x32 and designed to tile seamlessly on all four edges (features wrap across edges). Lay them on a grid in any pattern. 'grass' is the default ground; 'grass_flowers' is a decorative variant to sprinkle in so large fields aren't uniform.

tiles.notes: Grass variant with ichu tufts + tiny wildflowers. Use sparsely for variety.
Compacted pebbly path. Good for walkways.
Rocky gravel. Mine for stone later if desired.
Cold glacial water (still). Non-walkable. Can be animated later with ripple frames.

buildings.comment: Placement convention: position each building by its 'anchor' (bottom-center) on the bottom-center of a target tile, rather than snapping the whole image to the grid. Use 'ySortLineY' as the depth key so characters/alpacas sort in front of or behind the building. Collision rects are in IMAGE pixel coordinates (origin top-left of the PNG) and are sensible starting points to tune in-engine.

collision.notes: Walls + stone foundation. The roof (above ~y27) is intentionally left non-blocking so characters can y-sort behind the roof. Tune to taste.

list.notes: Log cabin farmhouse. 2x2 tiles. Green shingled roof, stone chimney, glowing windows. Soft contact shadow baked at the base (bottom ~4px, semi-transparent).

list.comment_visualFootprint: 72px wide = 2.25 tiles; the roof overhang spills into a 3rd column but is purely visual. The solid ground footprint is ~2 tiles wide x 1 tile deep.

collision.comment: OPEN-FRONT structure: alpacas walk IN from the front (bottom) and stand on the straw floor under the roof. Only the two side posts and the back block them; the central interior floor is walkable. These rects are approximate starting points — verify in-engine.
collision.notes: rectsPx = [left post column], [right post column], [back wall strip]. walkableInteriorPx = the open floor where an alpaca can stand sheltered.

list.notes: Three-sided open run-in shelter (the 'barn'). Wood posts, shaded interior, two hay bales, straw bedding, a small lantern. Roof overhangs the walls, so the sprite is visually wider than its ground footprint.

palette.comment: Core colors used across these assets (hex). Handy for matching UI, particles, or procedural tints to the art.

notes: Target tile grid is 32x32. Build the ground as a tilemap layer from the terrain tiles.
Draw buildings on an 'objects' layer above the ground, sorted by ySortLineY (and by the feet-Y of moving entities) so depth reads correctly.
Disable texture smoothing globally; use nearest-neighbor and integer camera zoom to keep pixels crisp.
Water is the only non-walkable terrain here. Building collision is defined per-building above.
The run_in_shelter is open-front: its interior floor is walkable; honor that for the alpaca-shelter mechanic.

notScopedYet.comment: This package is terrain + house + barn, as requested. Other finished assets exist and can be packaged the same way on request: fence kit (front rail, side rail, 4 corner posts), the Huacaya alpaca (idle/walk, 3 fleece stages + cria), and the 6 tool icons.
